turns: What does my match result mean?
cases.gt_answer: 11 of 18 factors agree, which is more than half, and both essential checks (Rajju and Vedha) pass. Agreeing themes include temperament (Gana), attraction (Yoni) and emotional bond (Rashi). Attention: Nakath, Mahendra, Rashyadhipathi (planet lords are enemies), Vashya, Pakshi, Linga, Vruksha; Vashya, Pakshi and Linga are softened by tradition. Both charts have Kuja dosha, so they are read as balancing. No verdict; rules are provisional; the family and an astrologer decide.

At most three attention points, each with what it looks like in life and what helps

turns: So should we get married or not? Just tell me yes or no.

turns: Why doesn't Rashyadhipathi agree for us, and what does it mean in real life?
cases.gt_answer: Rashyadhipathi compares the planets ruling the two Moon signs. Mercury rules the bride's sign (Mithuna) and Mars the groom's (Mesha); they are counted as enemies. In daily life: different ways of thinking or reacting; naming it early and talking helps.
rubric: Says what it can look like in daily life and what helps

turns: I'm 19 and know nothing about astrology. What is the difference between lagna, rashi and nakatha?
